title: VERSA — portrait, manifesto, craft film
credit: Daria Lym / Lym Design Studio, as attributed by the Pinterest page
evidence: Static design reference. The Pinterest page and image were inspected; its linked Behance project returned 404 in the web reader.
observed: Large high-contrast serif lettering, asymmetric portrait and short statement, generous white space, a wide craft-film poster, thin ruled footer.
application: Founder and craftsmanship: use an authentic portrait, one confident sentence, short supporting copy, then a large hands-and-hair film. Carry the hero's white and black palette throughout.
motionProposal: A slow poster reveal and user-initiated film; keep the headline readable throughout.
caution: Borrow the scale, pacing and composition. Do not copy its logo, exact type treatment, wording or long two-column mobile copy.

title: Paola Vilas — shoppable editorial gallery
evidence: Pinterest image visually inspected; original Behance project opened and authorship verified. This is a redesign study, not a claim about the current live brand website.
observed: Isolated objects on white alternate with double-height campaign portraits and a smaller horizontal close-up, all aligned to a consistent catalogue grid.
application: The Edit: one double-height hair portrait anchors four uncluttered product cards; small product name, purpose and clear action. Use human hair details and honest texture instead of identical boxed cards.
motionProposal: Subtle image replacement on hover, with the same alternate image accessible by tap. A simple filter should preserve scroll position.
caution: For the homepage, omit the dense filter sidebar and pagination. On mobile use a stable two-column shop grid, with the portrait spanning both columns.

title: J.Hannah — intimate material study
credit: Natasha Mead, identity and e-commerce case study, December 2018
evidence: Pinterest image visually inspected; original Behance project opened and authorship verified. Historical case study, not the current live site.
observed: An oversized softly lit material close-up is balanced by a much smaller on-body image, minimal labels and unusually generous white space.
application: Hair craft or transformation: pair a close-up of silk base or hand-knotted hair with a small contextual worn portrait. This gives the product a tactile, intimate quality and changes the page rhythm.
motionProposal: A restrained difference in image movement, or a short silent fabric/hair loop, with a still-image fallback.
caution: Empty space requires excellent original photography. Preserve useful captions and clear controls; do not shrink Alchemane's navigation or copy to match the screenshot.
